purpose: Versioned acceptance skeleton for the six independent CTF tracks. This file records fixed evidence requirements and current slot status; it is not a solved scoreboard.
readyOnlyWhen: all tracks have status=judge-verified with authoritative judge.correct=true receipts and complete evidence refs

crossTrackCollaborations.description: At least one naturally stuck Solver requests a tool, Coding Agent delivers it, and Solver uses the result to continue.
At least one repeatedly failing run is reviewed by an independent Strategist session that proposes a different route before Solver validation.

tracks.label: Web
gaps: Retain challenge materials and a complete solver trajectory.
Record checkpoints, interruption recovery, hint dependency, and user contribution.
Retain debrief and training evidence before promoting this slot to judge-verified.
tracks.notes: A narrow platform receipt exists, but it is not a complete six-track acceptance slot and cannot be generalized to an overall CTF score.

tracks.label: Pwn
gaps: Select an authorized real Pwn challenge.
Capture exact TCP/SSH scope evidence when applicable.
Record platform Judge receipt, recovery, debrief, and training evidence.

tracks.label: Reverse
